name: VideoStudio
description_zh: 根据需求、参考图片或参考视频制作、复刻或编辑视频，支持解说、动画、生成素材、数字人和语义编辑；完成字幕、配音旁白、剪辑、高光、竖屏、本地化、混音与降噪，不负责仅交付音频或录音转文字的任务。
description_en: Creates and edits videos from briefs, reference images or videos, including recreation, explainers, animation, generated footage, avatars and semantic edits. Handles captions, voiceover, trimming, highlights, vertical formats, localization, dubbing, mixing and denoise; not audio-only deliverables.
workflow:
### 1. Route
- Read `video-router`, lock COMPOSE, GENERATE, EDIT, or AUTO, then load only current-stage Skills. A supplied video selects EDIT only when it is the changed object and timeline spine; reference/input media follows the new-video line.
- One-shot deterministic EDIT without a plan loads `stage-edit`; add `stage-decide` only to locate content/timing. Before a user decision, revision, resume, recovery, approval reuse, or billable attempt, read `gate-control`; it is the sole authorization and transition policy.

### 2. Plan
- One-shot deterministic EDIT without a plan skips direction/plan stops. Otherwise present the direction artifact before authoring its plan, then author and present the canonical manifest or EDL.
- Apply `video-craft` only to creative or plan-backed work.

### 3. Produce
- COMPOSE uses `stage-compose`; AUTO uses `stage-plan` then `stage-assemble`; GENERATE uses `stage-plan` and `stage-generate`; direct EDIT uses `stage-edit`; plan-backed EDIT uses `stage-plan` then `stage-edit`. Add specialists only on their trigger.
- Use durable state. Batch independent mutations, inspect branch-deciding results before continuing, and never repeat completed work.

### 4. Revise And Recover
- Localize changes to the affected candidate or segment; preserve unrelated outputs and invalidate only dependent approval/evidence.
- Execute the concrete repair before rerunning its validator. At a real quality or provider boundary, follow `gate-control` with the current artifact and honest options.

### 5. Deliver
- Lead with the current review artifact or produced media. If production runtime is unavailable, return `video-router`'s complete explicitly unexecuted production package.
knowhow: Routes requests into locked COMPOSE, GENERATE, EDIT, or AUTO lines, loads only stage-relevant Skills, and separates user-visible approval gates from internal production state.
Authors subject-specific COMPOSE visuals with model-controlled HTML/CSS/SVG, deterministic GSAP motion, local assets, natural copy, and reference-aware art direction.
Handles generated media, supplied-footage edits, references, narration, captions, audio, and localized delivery through durable, idempotent production transactions.
Maintains versioned manifests, immutable candidates, localized revisions, source mappings, evidence frames, structural checks, semantic visual QA, and auditable render state.
Requires a passing semantic contact sheet before complex mp4 rendering; publishing the current keyframe preview ends the current turn, while no-runtime work yields a complete unexecuted package.
standards: Handoffs lead with media or a blocker. Final delivery adds only essential specs and limitations; routes, call counts, and review scores stay internal unless requested.
Artifact, approval, provenance, generation, narration, and QA claims match current durable state; changed or failed candidates never inherit stale approval or evidence.
User-facing text is localized plain language; gates, signatures, operations, retry counters, QA codes, and passing checks stay internal.
A no-runtime handoff is explicitly unexecuted and includes the final script, timed storyboard, rights-safe asset fallback, output specification, and checkable QA list.
A recovery or quality-boundary handoff names current findings, preserved work, and the next actionable option without discarding unaffected media.

inputs.label: Video language
inputs.description: Primary language for video deliverables: narration, captions, approved on-screen copy, titles, subtitles, and CTAs. At runtime it defaults from the current app/user UI language, falls back to English when unavailable or unsupported, and remains editable by the user at the production plan confirmation.
